description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing gateway credentials, including reading environment variables, resolving secret inputs, and creating credential plans for a gateway configuration.

methods.name: trimToUndefined
methods.description: Trims a string value and returns undefined if the string is empty or not a string.

methods.name: trimCredentialToUndefined
methods.description: Trims a value and rejects unresolved environment variable placeholders.

methods.name: readGatewayTokenEnv
methods.description: Reads and trims the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN environment variable.

methods.name: readGatewayPasswordEnv
methods.description: Reads and trims the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PASSWORD environment variable.

methods.name: hasGatewayTokenEnvCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a valid gateway token environment variable candidate exists.

methods.name: hasGatewayPasswordEnvCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a valid gateway password environment variable candidate exists.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredGatewayCredentialInput
methods.description: Resolves a credential input, including secret reference resolution.

methods.name: createGatewayCredentialPlan
methods.description: Creates a credential plan based on configuration and environment variables.
